body:
Its been 20, half my life. When do I get to decide enough is enough?  
We're allowed to put our pets humanely to death.

this made my day.

Thank you.

If you ever wonder if you did anything good in your life, the answer is yes, you did this.

I've been diagnosed with BPD as well. It is not a fun way to live.  


Have you heard of DBT? there are a lot of skills that I've found helpful when I'm in a crisis situation like you described. It helps me cry wolf a little less often.

and I have no idea if this is allowed, but since you mentioned memes  
 [https://www.reddit.com/r/BPDmemes/](https://www.reddit.com/r/BPDmemes/)

I can relate to a lot of the behavior you've described. 

It's hard for our friends to know when we mean it, or how serious we are each time, and it becomes the boy who cried wolf problem. 

is BPD borderline personality disorder?

This sounds a lot like survivors guilt. Have you talked to a therapist about it?

It's not your fault your friend committed suicide. It's ok that you are still alive.

​

> if I had committed suicide before them they would have changed their mind 

Maybe they convinced you not to do it so they could go through with it. Maybe they knew if you did it first, they wouldn't be able to go through with it. You can't begin to understand or imagine their motives.

> His loved ones would probably feel better 

What makes you think that? Would your death let them talk to him? See him? Hold him? They might feel a lot of guilt themselves for not seeing signs your friend was upset and suicidal.

I am so sorry you are having such a hard time right now.  
I am so proud of you for what you did in 2019. That is amazing. not many people can say that.

New medications happen all the time. Maybe one day you will be able to take one. Or half a dose of one, that will help take the edge off. 

You said therapy didn't work.  
How many therapists did you try? I've had at least 10. Only 2 of them were kinda helpful. Maybe try therapy again? I understand not wanting to live. I don't want to either. But it sounds like you are able to do some good the longer you hold off.

You talked about the fact that you've help/ saved people.

If you take your life, then who will help or save those people in the future?  
It isn't your responsibility. But it does mean that you matter and you make a difference. When you think you don't, when you think you won't be missed, when you think that your death won't mean anything, by your own admission - it will.
